description: Search verified Common Room venues in Hong Kong by type, with optional district, date, number of people and budget. Types offered: hourly_hotel = Hourly hotels / 時鐘酒店; party_room = Party Rooms in Hong Kong / Party Room 香港; event_venue = Event Venue Hong Kong / 場地租用 (商業) 香港; restaurant_private_room = Private Room Restaurant Hong Kong / 包房餐廳 / 餐廳包場; junk_boat = Boat Party / Junk Hong Kong / 船p / 遊船河 租船; serviced_apartment = Serviced Apartment in Hong Kong  / Service Apartment Hong Kong (服務式住宅香港) 月租/短租. For serviced_apartment it returns only the category page link; do not recommend apartments.

budget.description: Maximum starting price in HKD, as shown on the listing.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD (Hong Kong time). For hourly hotels, only hotels with open times that day are returned.

district.description: Hong Kong district in English or Chinese, such as "Mong Kok" or "旺角".

name: search_venues
title: Search venues
